title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Darkroom. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Darkroom
options.lineage: analog darkroom, developing tank, contact sheet
options.thesis: The phone is a light-tight room: the vault never sees daylight, and the internet never sees the vault.
options.viewport: Full-bleed dark. A tank-as-phone at left. Contact-sheet headline in a safelight pool. GitHub APK as the print you take out.
options.risk: Reads as photo-hipster nostalgia if the trays are not literally master password, recovery key, and .vault.

raised.raise: Ballistic mass: type and safelight settle with overshoot; nothing eases in like a UI fade.
Light-trap edge: the scrape-world outside has no seam; the vault is a hard black frame that does not leak.
Local glow, then dark: pointer only lights what you touch; leaving it, the safelight dies — auto-lock, no residue.

options.label: Sneakernet
options.lineage: USB sticks, Nearby Share, labeled envelopes
options.thesis: BitVault is one encrypted file you carry, not a product you log into.
options.viewport: A full-scale labeled .vault object owns the first screen; the phone is the destination, not the hero chrome.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on, because the mechanism is the file.

options.label: The One Lift
options.lineage: ebru floated pigment, one contact with paper
options.thesis: Recovery key and backup are a single irreversible lift: the only copy there will ever be.
options.viewport: A full-bleed bath; BitVault type is combed into the surface; GitHub is the lift.
options.case: Holds product clarity on irreversibility; loses identification — visitors are not marblers.
options.risk: Reads as a luxury art site unless the lift is named as recovery key and .vault.

options.label: Civic Prospectus
options.thesis: Almost everything is bone-white; the argument lives in two weights of one face and one violet action.
options.viewport: Sticky 72px bar, 88px headline, ribbon owning the right bleed, GitHub as the only filled button.
options.case: Holds audience identification with premium web they already trust; loses clarity — no-internet and .vault stay polite.
options.risk: Looks like every awarded SaaS prospectus unless the ribbon is the file path, not décor.

options.label: Opposing Wraps
options.lineage: tensegrity column, carbon rods and red cord
options.thesis: Master password and recovery key are opposing wraps: the vault key floats and never touches disk in the clear.
options.viewport: A breathing column as the first object; labels name password wrap vs recovery wrap; GitHub at the base plate.
options.case: Holds product clarity on the key model; loses identification — the audience does not live in sculpture studios.
options.risk: Becomes a kinetic-art demo that forgets logins, photos, and the APK.

options.label: Meters at Rest
options.lineage: VU-meter bridge on a recording desk
options.thesis: Cloud products lean into the red together; BitVault’s needles sleep on the left pin — nothing leaving.
options.viewport: A row of meters as the hero; BitVault’s channel is at rest; GitHub under the bridge.
options.case: Loses both: studio meters are not this audience, and rest vs peak does not name password, recovery, or .vault.
options.kept: Ballistic mass — motion with overshoot, not UI fades.
options.risk: Reads as an audio plugin site.

options.label: Seamless Wave
options.thesis: The scrape-world has no edge you can find; the vault is the only hard black frame.
options.viewport: A continuous optical field; BitVault sits in a light-trap window; GitHub cuts the wave.
options.case: Loses both: gallery op-art is not their world, and a seamless field fights a product about edges and one file.
options.kept: Light-trap edge — outside has no seam, the vault does not leak.
options.risk: Becomes an optical toy with no mental model.

options.label: Wake Then Dark
options.thesis: Touch draws light that dies; nothing persists in the water once you leave.
options.viewport: Black field; pointer wakes name the four keys; darkness closes; GitHub is a still dock.
options.case: Loses both: night-sea mood is not identification, and plankton cannot carry .vault or recovery-once.
options.kept: Local glow, then dark — light only where you are, then residue gone.
options.risk: Awwwards particle demo that could sell any night-themed app.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark security landing: lock mark, encrypted claim, phone mock, feature grid, store badge — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Nav, headline plus subcopy, phone screenshot, primary download, logo row of nothing we do not have.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other password-manager site by design.
